entities.title: Family calendar
entities.summary: One Worker, one D1 and a static client: a household's shared weekly schedules, at icelander.net/calendar, signed in through icelander.net's login service.
entities.purpose: Lets each person in a household, and children or others without a sign-in, keep weekly schedules (work, school, lessons) with alternating weeks and per-day exceptions, and lets the household see one person's week or everyone's.
boundaries: Identity and sign-in (Google and the rest) belong to the login service in the icelander.net repository; this repository vendors its client library and never edits it.
The calendar knows a person only by the login service's id, plus the name and picture it last saw.
Nothing is hidden inside a household: no private or busy-only schedules.
